description: Get the public details of one ZMRM stay: description, amenities, house rules, check-in and check-out times, cancellation policy summary, images and location (approximate, rounded to about 1 km). With complete dates and guests it also returns a full price quote with the nightly breakdown, stamped with priced_at and valid_until (advisory, not a hold). Show the `url` to the user (it opens the stay, with these dates and guests filled in when you gave them); cite `page_url`, the plain stay page. The answer also lists payment_methods and a payment_note, once; vouchers (including the Cal reservist voucher, שובר מילואים) and gift cards apply to ILS checkouts only. Club-card discounts apply to ILS checkouts only and are applied at payment; if the guest asks about a club or benefit card, call get_search_options, which lists the customer clubs (names only, no rate). Read-only.

agent.description: Your client's name (e.g. "chatgpt", "claude"), used only to attribute the visit; optional.

check_in.description: Arrival day, YYYY-MM-DD (Israel time). Today or later. Give dates and adults to get a price quote.

check_out.description: Departure day, YYYY-MM-DD, after check_in. get_search_options gives the longest stay (max_nights).

children.description: Number of children, not counting infants. Defaults to 0.

currency.description: Also show the price converted to EUR or USD (approximate). Prices are always quoted in ILS agorot; omit for ILS only.

id.description: The stay: its id (uuid) from search_stays, or its ZMRM page path such as /zimmer/<category>/<region>/<city>/<slug>.

locale.description: Language of the returned names and of the stay links (he, en, fr, es, de, it, ru, ar). Defaults to he.

nationality.description: Lead guest's nationality, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 in capitals (e.g. "IL", "US"). Some hotel rates depend on it. Defaults to IL.

pets.description: True when the guests bring a pet; it is filled into the stay link. It does not filter results: check house_rules.pets_allowed in get_stay.

name: get_stay
